title: 1st sitting of the 20th Majlis
presiding: Ahmed Siyam Mohamed (Meedhoo) as longest-serving member until the Speaker was elected; then Speaker Abdul Raheem Abdulla (Fonadhoo); Deputy Speaker Ahmed Nazim (Dhiggaru) after the midday recess
summary: At the first sitting of the 20th Majlis, all 93 members were present. They elected a five-member committee to count secret ballots, then chose Abdul Raheem Abdulla (Fonadhoo) as Speaker with 71 votes against 14 for Ibrahim Nazil, and Ahmed Nazim (Dhiggaru) as Deputy Speaker with 80 votes against 12 for Ahmed Didi. The new Speaker took the chair and gave an address. The Majlis then debated how to work without its own rules yet, agreed to keep using the 19th Majlis rules until new ones are passed, and set the size of the standing committees.

decisions: A five-member vote-counting committee was formed (92 in favour, none against).
Abdul Raheem Abdulla (Fonadhoo) was elected Speaker of the 20th Majlis.
Ahmed Nazim (Dhiggaru) was elected Deputy Speaker.
The Majlis will use the 19th Majlis rules until the 20th Majlis rules are passed; the general committee must draft them by 26 June 2024.

Standing committees set at 13 members for the Article 241 security services committee and 11 members for the others; parties and independents to send committee names to the Secretariat by Sunday 2 June 2024.
The next sitting is set for Monday 3 June 2024 at 9:00.
